metas.name: Love, Death & Robots
metas.description: A collection of animated short stories that span various genres including science fiction, fantasy, horror and comedy.

metas.name: Barry
metas.description: A hitman from the Midwest moves to Los Angeles and gets caught up in the city's theatre arts scene.

metas.name: St. Denis Medical
metas.description: It follows an underfunded, understaffed hospital where the doctors and nurses try their best to treat patients while maintaining their own sanity.

metas.name: Behind Her Eyes
metas.description: It follows Louise, a single mum with a son and a part-time job in a psychiatrist's office. She begins an affair with her boss and strikes up an unlikely friendship with his wife.

metas.name: The Sandman
metas.description: Upon escaping after decades of imprisonment by a mortal wizard, Dream, the personification of dreams, sets about to reclaim his lost equipment.

metas.name: Taboo
metas.description: Adventurer James Keziah Delaney returns to London during the War of 1812 to rebuild his late father's shipping empire. However, both the government and his biggest competitor want his inheritance at any cost--even murder.

metas.name: The Last Ship
metas.description: The crew of a naval destroyer is forced to confront the reality of a new existence when a pandemic kills off most of the earth's population.

metas.name: Orange Is the New Black
metas.description: Convicted of a decade-old crime of transporting drug money, ordinarily law-abiding Piper Chapman is sentenced to 18 months behind bars and quickly discovers the realities of life-changing prison time.

metas.name: Black Sails
metas.description: Captain Flint and his pirates hunt treasure and fight for the survival of New Providence Island.

metas.name: See
metas.description: Far in a dystopian future, the human race has lost the sense of sight, and society has had to find new ways to interact, build, hunt, and to survive. All of that is challenged when a set of twins are born with sight.

metas.name: Ahsoka
metas.description: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, former Jedi Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

metas.name: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
metas.description: Set after the battle between Godzilla and the Titans, revealing that monsters are real, follows one family's journey to uncover its buried secrets and a legacy linking them to Monarch.

metas.name: 12 Monkeys
metas.description: Follows the journey of a time traveler from the post-apocalyptic future who appears in present day on a mission to locate and eradicate the source of a deadly plague that will nearly destroy the human race.

metas.name: Billions
metas.description: A complex drama about power politics in the world of New York high finance.

metas.name: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
metas.description: After her husband leaves her, young mother of two Miriam "Midge" Maisel discovers that she has a talent for stand-up comedy. Could this be her calling?

metas.name: Gossip Girl
metas.description: Narrated by a mysterious vicious blogger, this show follows a set of wealthy teenagers through their day-to-day scandalous lives as Manhattans Elite, and how they betray each other for each other's gain.

metas.name: Alice in Borderland
metas.description: Arisu - a listless, jobless and video-game-obsessed young man - suddenly finds himself in a strange, emptied-out version of Tokyo in which he and his friends must compete in dangerous games in order to survive.

metas.name: Blue Eye Samurai
metas.description: In Edo-period Japan, a young warrior driven by a dream of revenge cuts a bloody path toward destiny.

metas.name: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
metas.description: A team of Crime Scene Investigators (CSI's) work with the Las Vegas Police Department (LVPD) to solve crimes by using advanced scientific methods and technology in Las Vegas, Nevada.

metas.name: Cobra Kai
metas.description: Decades after their 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament bout, a middle-aged Daniel LaRusso and Johnny Lawrence find themselves martial-arts rivals again.

metas.name: 56 Days
metas.description: After a chance supermarket encounter, Oliver and Ciara embark on an intense relationship. When a savagely murdered corpse surfaces 56 days later, the investigation delves into their turbulent love story, revealing grim secrets.

metas.name: Mr. Mercedes
metas.description: A demented killer taunts a retired police detective with a series of lurid letters and emails, forcing the ex-cop to undertake a private, and potentially felonious, crusade to bring the killer to justice before he can strike again.

metas.name: Pretty Little Liars
metas.description: Four friends band together against an anonymous foe who threatens to reveal their darkest secrets, while also investigating the disappearance of their best friend.

metas.name: The Way Home
metas.description: Three generations of strong, independent women living together in the small farm town of Port Haven, embark on an enlightening journey none of them could have imagined, as they learn how to find their way back to each other.

metas.name: The Wheel of Time
metas.description: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever.

metas.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
metas.description: A love triangle between one girl and two brothers. A story about first love, first heartbreak, and the magic of that one perfect summer.

metas.name: Servant
metas.description: A Philadelphia couple are in mourning after an unspeakable tragedy creates a rift in their marriage and opens a door for a mysterious force to enter their home.

metas.name: The Strain
metas.description: A mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism ravages the city of New York.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: When her son vanishes after a play date at the park, a mother is thrust into a desperate search to uncover the truth behind his disappearance.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Former Senator Selina Meyer finds that being Vice President of the United States is nothing like she hoped and everything that everyone ever warned her about.

metas.name: Reasonable Doubt
metas.description: Jax Stewart juggles work, family, friends, and a complicated personal life as a brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system every chance she gets.

metas.name: Chilling Adventures of Sabrina
metas.description: Magic and mischief collide as half-human, half-witch Sabrina navigates between two worlds: mortal teen life and her family's legacy, the Church of Night.

metas.name: Station Eleven
metas.description: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: Dead City
metas.description: Maggie and Negan travel into a post-apocalyptic Manhattan long ago cut off from the mainland. The city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made New York City their own world.

metas.name: Where's Wanda?
metas.description: After the Klatts' daughter goes missing, they take matters into their own hands and hatch a wild plan: Spy on the neighborhood. As they make their way into small-time espionage, shocking secrets come to light one by one.

metas.name: Penny Dreadful
metas.description: Explorer Sir Malcolm Murray, American gunslinger Ethan Chandler, scientist Victor Frankenstein and medium Vanessa Ives unite to combat supernatural threats in Victorian London.

metas.name: The Closer
metas.description: Deputy Police Chief Brenda Johnson investigates high-profile crimes.

metas.name: Entourage
metas.description: Film star Vince Chase navigates the vapid terrain of Los Angeles with a close circle of friends and his trusty agent.

metas.name: The Umbrella Academy
metas.description: A family of former child heroes, now grown apart, must reunite to continue to protect the world.

metas.name: Moon Knight
metas.description: Steven Grant discovers he's been granted the powers of an Egyptian moon god. But he soon finds out that these newfound powers can be both a blessing and a curse to his troubled life.

metas.name: Margo's Got Money Troubles
metas.description: A young mother struggles to make ends meet. When her estranged father offers help, she starts an OnlyFans account using his advice from pro wrestling. Though successful, she wonders if Internet fame comes at too high a cost.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: Set 400 years in the future, the crew of the U.S.S. Orville continue their mission of exploration, navigating both the mysteries of the universe, and the complexities of their own interpersonal relationships.

metas.name: 13 Reasons Why
metas.description: Follows teenager Clay Jensen, in his quest to uncover the story behind his classmate and crush, Hannah, and her decision to end her life.

metas.name: Gone
metas.description: Local Headmaster Michael Polly who becomes the prime suspect in his wife Sarah's disappearance when he encounters gutsy Detective Annie Cassidy in a compulsive game of cat and mouse.

metas.name: Get Jiro!
metas.description: In a future LA controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a vicious culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

metas.name: Manifest
metas.description: When a commercial airliner suddenly reappears after being missing for five years, those aboard must reintegrate into society.

metas.name: Rooster
metas.description: A comedy revolving around an author's intricate bond with his daughter, set against the backdrop of a college campus.

metas.name: Elementary
metas.description: A crime-solving duo that cracks the NYPD's most impossible cases. Following his fall from grace in London, eccentric Sherlock escapes to New York where his father forces him to live with his worst nightmare--a sober companion, Dr....

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: When hitman Angelo is hit with early onset Alzheimer's, his worlds collide, putting his family in danger.

metas.name: Riverdale
metas.description: While navigating the troubled waters of romance, school and family, Archie and his gang become entangled in dark Riverdale mysteries.

metas.name: Silicon Valley
metas.description: Follows the struggle of Richard Hendricks, a Silicon Valley engineer trying to build his own company called Pied Piper.

metas.name: What If...?
metas.description: Exploring pivotal moments from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and turning them on their head, leading the audience into uncharted territory.

metas.name: Gotham
metas.description: The story behind Detective James Gordon's rise to prominence in Gotham City in the years before Batman's arrival.

metas.name: Mayfair Witches
metas.description: A neurosurgeon discovers she is the unlikely heir to a family of witches and must contend with a sinister presence that has haunted her family for generations.

metas.name: The Midnight Club
metas.description: At a hospice for terminally ill young adults, eight patients come together every night at midnight to tell each other stories - and make a pact that the next of them to die will give the group a sign from the beyond.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
metas.description: Daryl's journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home.

metas.name: Bates Motel
metas.description: An intimate look into the unraveling of Norman Bates' psyche throughout his teenage years.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: Based on the events surrounding the 1988 Lockerbie bombing. Lockerbie will focus on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved...

metas.name: Heartstopper
metas.description: Charlie, a high-strung, openly gay overthinker, and Nick, a cheerful, soft-hearted rugby player, one day are made to sit together in class. Their friendship becomes something more for Charlie, but he does not believe he has a chance.

metas.name: The Fall
metas.description: A Detective Superintendent from England investigates a politically-sensitive murder in Belfast.

metas.name: The Devil's Hour
metas.description: A woman wakes up every night at exactly 3.33AM, in the middle of the so-called devil's hour between 3AM and 4AM.

metas.name: The End of the F***ing World
metas.description: James is 17 and is pretty sure he is a psychopath. Alyssa, also 17, is the cool and moody new girl at school. The pair make a connection and she persuades him to embark on a road trip in search of her real father.

metas.name: Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent
metas.description: Follows an elite squad of Canadian police detectives who investigate high-profile crimes and corruption in metro Toronto, Ontario.

metas.name: C.B. Strike
metas.description: Private investigator and war veteran Cormoran Strike and his assistant Robin Ellacott use their unique skills to investigate complex cases that the London police are unable to solve.

metas.name: Unforgotten
metas.description: London detectives investigate crimes from the past, unravelling secrets left buried for years.

metas.name: The Empress
metas.description: Two young people meet. A fateful encounter - the proverbial love at first sight. He is Emperor Franz Joseph of Austria-Hungary, she is Elisabeth von Wittelsbach, Princess of Bavaria and the sister of the woman Franz is to marry.

metas.name: A Discovery of Witches
metas.description: Forbidden love blossoms between a witch and vampire after an ancient manuscript is uncovered, pitting them against supernatural forces vying for its coveted secrets.

metas.name: One Punch Man
metas.description: Saitama, a superhero who can defeat any foe with a single punch, battles boredom as he searches for a worthy opponent in a world plagued by monsters.

metas.name: Legion
metas.description: David Haller is a troubled young man diagnosed as schizophrenic, but after a strange encounter he discovers special powers that will change his life forever.

metas.name: White Collar
metas.description: A white-collar criminal agrees to help the FBI catch other white-collar criminals using his expertise as an art and securities thief, counterfeiter, and conman.

metas.name: Murderbot
metas.description: A security android struggles with emotions and free will while balancing dangerous missions and desire for isolation, evading detection of its self-hacking as it finds its place.

metas.name: Veronica Mars
metas.description: After her best friend is murdered, her father is removed as county sheriff, and her mother abruptly leaves town, Veronica Mars dedicates her life to cracking the toughest mysteries in the mostly affluent town of Neptune.

metas.name: Untamed
metas.description: In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain, where nature obeys no rules but its own.

metas.name: Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities
metas.description: Bizarre nightmares unfold in eight tales of terror in a visually stunning, spine-tingling horror collection curated by Guillermo del Toro.

metas.name: Castlevania
metas.description: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly creatures controlled by Dracula.

metas.name: Unbelievable
metas.description: A teenager is charged with lying about being raped, but two detectives follow the path to the truth.

metas.name: Oz
metas.description: Follows the daily activities of the Inmates at the Oswald Maximum Security Correctional Facility (aka "Oz" for short), an unusual prison where its criminal inhabitants face challenges head on behind bars and do all they can to sta...

metas.name: Married... with Children
metas.description: Al is the quintessential working class dad. Peggy, his wife, always wants more from him. With their children, they go through the highs and lows of ordinary life.

metas.name: Long Bright River
metas.description: A Philadelphia police officer searches for her sister, an addict who has gone missing.

metas.name: The Hunting Party
metas.description: Follows a team who are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

metas.name: Orphan Black
metas.description: A streetwise hustler is pulled into a compelling conspiracy after witnessing the suicide of a girl who looks just like her.

metas.name: Top Boy
metas.description: A group of young people living on edge and out of sight in the crime-riddled area of East London today.

metas.name: Power
metas.description: James "Ghost" St. Patrick--a wealthy New York nightclub owner who has it all: dreaming big, catering to the city's elite, and living a double life as a drug kingpin.

metas.name: American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: The King of Queens
metas.description: Deliveryman Doug Heffernan has a good life: He has a pretty wife (Carrie), a big television, and friends with which to watch it. Then Carrie's goofy, annoying father Arthur moves in with them.

metas.name: Virgin River
metas.description: Seeking a fresh start, nurse practitioner Melinda Monroe moves from Los Angeles to a remote Northern California town and is surprised by what and whom she finds there.

metas.name: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
metas.description: Set in the flamboyant 1930s, “This is not a murder mystery” reunites world renowned Surrealist artists, including young Salvador Dalí and René Magritte, who find themselves trapped in a lavish mansion with a mysterious serial killer on the loose.

metas.name: Detective Hole
metas.description: A brilliant but troubled detective, Harry Hole, hunts a serial killer while battling a corrupt adversary, Tom Waaler, as they navigate ethical gray areas, with Harry determined to bring the criminal to justice.

metas.name: Atlanta
metas.description: Earn and his cousin Alfred try to make their way in the world through Atlanta's rap scene. Along the way they come face-to-face with social and economic issues touching on race, relationships, poverty, status, and parenthood.

metas.name: Everybody Loves Raymond
metas.description: Ray Barone, a successful sports writer and family man, deals with a resentful brother and meddling parents who happen to live across the street.

metas.name: Hazbin Hotel
metas.description: In an attempt to find a non-violent alternative for reducing Hell's overpopulation, the daughter of Lucifer opens a rehabilitation hotel that offers a group of misfit demons a chance at redemption.

metas.name: X-Men '97
metas.description: A band of mutants use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them; they're challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

metas.name: Ash vs Evil Dead
metas.description: Ash has spent the last thirty years avoiding responsibility, maturity, and the terrors of the Evil Dead until a Deadite plague threatens to destroy all of mankind and Ash becomes mankind's only hope.
A teacher gets a chance to travel back in time to stop the murder of John F. Kennedy. However, history's aversion to alteration, and his love for the era and a woman, endanger him.

metas.name: Doc Martin
metas.description: The trials and tribulations of Martin Ellingham, a brilliant but socially challenged doctor who moves from London to the picturesque village of Port Wenn in Cornwall.

metas.name: Lonesome Dove
metas.description: Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and several other residents of a small Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.

metas.name: Skins
metas.description: The messy lives, loves, delirious highs and inevitable lows of raucous teenage friends in Bristol.

metas.name: Jessica Jones
metas.description: Following the tragic end of her brief superhero career, Jessica Jones tries to rebuild her life as a private investigator, dealing with cases involving people with remarkable abilities in New York City.

metas.name: The Five-Star Weekend
metas.description: A beloved food influencer grapples with loss and hosts four friends from different chapters of her life for a weekend in Nantucket, where hidden truths emerge and relationships evolve amid coastal luxury.

metas.name: Rizzoli & Isles
metas.description: Boston's assertive detective Jane Rizzoli and steady medical examiner Maura Isles hail from very different economic backgrounds, but the strong, competent women effectively work together to solve the city's most puzzling crimes.
